applicabilityBasis.summary: KRWQ is marketed as a fully backed, fixed-KRW stablecoin for global payments, settlement and trading, so it was reviewed as an apparent payment stablecoin. Public issuer materials attribute the project to IQ using Frax infrastructure but do not resolve the legally obligated issuing entity.

genius.notes: issuerEntity retains the existing IQ/Frax project attribution for issuer-key consistency; it is not verification of the exact legal issuer or redemption obligor. issuerDomicile is omitted because Korean founding-team links and global offshore marketing do not establish the legal issuer's domicile; the actual mint page excludes Korean residents, citizens and persons located in Korea. Eligible whitelisted counterparties can mint/redeem; the public UI currently quotes USDC conversion and unrestricted retail fiat redemption is not established. The current site says attestations are published as issued, while the whitepaper describes future independent reports; no actual dated monthly independent report was found. IQ's GENIUS-compatible Frax-infrastructure claim is not a named approval, pending application or specific intention to pursue a GENIUS license for KRWQ. Treasury's August 17 proposal gives January 18, 2027 as the expected effectiveness date, subject to the statutory final-rule trigger. The September 30 SCRC interim final rule is procedural. not-yet-restricted describes only GENIUS's phased DASP restriction, not general U.S. legality or authorization. The broad DASP prohibition starts July 18, 2028; the foreign lawful-order condition starts when the Act becomes effective.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The opened issuer disclosures, OCC pending applications, NYDFS tables and official-domain searches disclosed no token-specific KRWQ/IQ GENIUS approval, state qualification, official application or foreign registration as of 2026-10-07. Exact legal issuer identity remains unresolved. GENIUS-compatible infrastructure and partner reserve assets do not establish authorization or a concrete KRWQ GENIUS filing plan; absence from a bank-charter table is not proof of no confidential filing.
